stem.en: The nurse prepares to administer digoxin to an 8-year-old with heart failure. Before giving the dose, the nurse counts an apical pulse of 68 beats/min for one full minute. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 護理師準備給予一名8歲心衰竭兒童毛地黃前，測得心尖脈為68次/分（測滿1分鐘）。護理師應如何處置？

options.en: Administer the dose because 68 beats/min is normal for this age
options.zh: 給藥，因68次/分對此年齡屬正常

options.en: Withhold the dose and notify the health care provider
options.zh: 暫停給藥並通知醫療人員

options.en: Administer only half of the prescribed dose
options.zh: 僅給予處方劑量的一半

options.en: Recheck the pulse in 4 hours and give the dose if it has improved
options.zh: 4小時後再測脈搏，若有改善再給藥

why.en: Digoxin should be withheld and the provider notified if the apical pulse is below 90-110 beats/min in infants/young children or below 70 beats/min in older children, as this may indicate toxicity-related bradycardia. The dose is never independently adjusted.
why.zh: 嬰幼兒心尖脈低於90-110次/分、較大兒童低於70次/分時應暫停毛地黃並通知醫師，因過低心率可能提示中毒相關之心搏過緩；劑量絕不可自行調整。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child receiving both furosemide and digoxin for heart failure is being monitored for electrolyte complications. Which findings should alert the nurse to possible hypokalemia in this child? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 一名同時使用furosemide與毛地黃治療心衰竭的兒童正接受電解質併發症監測。下列哪些發現應提醒護理師注意可能的低血鉀？（複選）

options.en: Serum potassium of 3.1 mEq/L (3.1 mmol/L)
options.zh: 血清鉀3.1 mEq/L（3.1 mmol/L）

options.en: Muscle weakness and leg cramping
options.zh: 肌肉無力與小腿抽筋

options.en: Increased restlessness and confusion
options.zh: 躁動不安與意識混亂加重

options.en: Inverted T waves with prominent U waves on the ECG
options.zh: 心電圖上T波倒置合併明顯U波

options.en: Bounding peripheral pulses
options.zh: 周邊脈搏洪大

options.en: Serum potassium of 4.6 mEq/L (4.6 mmol/L)
options.zh: 血清鉀4.6 mEq/L（4.6 mmol/L）

why.en: Hypokalemia (potassium below 3.5 mEq/L) presents with muscle weakness/cramping, confusion, irritability/restlessness, and inverted T waves or prominent U waves on the ECG. Because hypokalemia potentiates digoxin toxicity, these findings must be reported promptly. A potassium of 4.6 mEq/L is within the normal range (3.5-5.0), and bounding pulses are unrelated to hypokalemia.
why.zh: 低血鉀（K+ <3.5 mEq/L）表現為肌肉無力/抽筋、意識混亂、躁動不安，以及心電圖T波倒置/U波明顯；因低血鉀會加重毛地黃中毒風險，須及時通報。血鉀4.6 mEq/L屬正常範圍（3.5-5.0），脈搏洪大與低血鉀無關。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: An infant with heart failure is prescribed an ACE inhibitor (captopril). Which parameters should the nurse monitor while this medication is administered? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 一名心衰竭嬰兒使用ACE抑制劑（captopril）。使用此藥期間，護理師應監測下列哪些項目？（複選）

options.en: Blood pressure, for hypotension
options.zh: 血壓，以偵測低血壓

options.en: BUN and creatinine, for renal dysfunction
options.zh: BUN與肌酸酐，以偵測腎功能異常

options.en: Presence of a persistent dry cough
options.zh: 是否出現持續性乾咳

options.en: Urine output and urinary specific gravity
options.zh: 尿量與尿液比重

options.en: Fasting blood glucose level
options.zh: 空腹血糖值

options.en: Serum calcium level
options.zh: 血清鈣離子濃度

why.en: The chapter directs the nurse to monitor blood pressure, renal function (BUN, creatinine, serum protein/albumin), WBC count, urine output/specific gravity/protein, and cough when ACE inhibitors are given, because of the risks of hypotension, renal dysfunction, and cough. Glucose and calcium are not specific monitoring parameters for this medication.
why.zh: 教材指出使用ACE抑制劑時應監測血壓、腎功能（BUN、肌酸酐、血清蛋白/白蛋白）、白血球數、尿量/尿比重/尿蛋白，以及咳嗽，因可能造成低血壓、腎功能異常與咳嗽；血糖與血鈣並非此藥特定監測項目。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is reviewing congenital heart defects that increase pulmonary blood flow. Which statements are accurate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 護理師複習會增加肺血流量的先天性心臟缺損。下列哪些敘述正確？（複選）

options.en: "An atrial septal defect allows oxygenated blood to shunt into the right side of the heart and may be closed during cardiac catheterization."
options.zh: 「心房中隔缺損（ASD）使含氧血分流至右心，可於心導管檢查時關閉缺損。」

options.en: "A small-to-moderate ventricular septal defect commonly closes spontaneously during the first year of life."
options.zh: 「小至中型心室中隔缺損（VSD）常於出生後第一年內自行閉合。」

options.en: "Patent ductus arteriosus produces a characteristic machinery-like murmur with bounding pulses and a widened pulse pressure."
options.zh: 「開放性動脈導管（PDA）會產生機械樣雜音，並伴隨脈搏洪大與脈壓增寬。」

options.en: "An atrioventricular canal defect is the cardiac defect most commonly associated with Down syndrome."
options.zh: 「房室管缺損是唐氏症最常合併的心臟缺損。」

options.en: "Tetralogy of Fallot is classified as a defect with increased pulmonary blood flow."
options.zh: 「法洛氏四重症屬於肺血流增加的缺損。」

why.en: ASD, VSD, PDA, and AV canal defect are left-to-right shunt lesions that increase pulmonary blood flow, so each of those statements is accurate. Tetralogy of Fallot is a defect with DECREASED pulmonary blood flow (right-to-left shunt), not increased.
why.zh: ASD、VSD、PDA與房室管缺損皆屬左向右分流，會增加肺血流量，各敘述皆正確；法洛氏四重症則是肺血流「減少」（右向左分流）的缺損，而非增加。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is assigned to four children on a pediatric cardiology unit. Which child should the nurse assess first?
stem.zh: 護理師被分配照顧心臟科病房四名兒童。護理師應優先評估哪一位？

options.en: A child 2 days post-cardiac catheterization who reports mild itching under the adhesive bandage
options.zh: 心導管檢查後第2天，主訴黏貼敷料下方輕微搔癢的兒童

options.en: An infant with known coarctation of the aorta whose blood pressure is 150/90 mm Hg in the right arm and 96/58 mm Hg in the right leg, with absent femoral pulses
options.zh: 已知主動脈縮窄的嬰兒，右手臂血壓150/90 mmHg、右下肢血壓96/58 mmHg，且股動脈脈搏消失

options.en: A child with Kawasaki disease in the convalescent stage who has a normal appearance
options.zh: 川崎病恢復期、外觀正常的兒童

options.en: A child recovering from cardiac surgery 5 days ago who is asking when they can return to school
options.zh: 心臟手術後第5天、詢問何時可返校的兒童

why.en: A markedly higher blood pressure in the arms than the legs with absent femoral pulses signals significant aortic obstruction and risk of inadequate lower-body perfusion in coarctation of the aorta, requiring prompt assessment and provider notification; the other findings are expected or low acuity.
why.zh: 上肢血壓明顯高於下肢且股動脈脈搏消失，提示主動脈縮窄造成嚴重阻塞，可能影響下半身灌流，須立即評估並通報；其他選項屬預期或低急迫性發現。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The parent of a 3-year-old with unrepaired tetralogy of Fallot reports that the child frequently stops playing to squat down for a minute before continuing. What should the nurse teach the parent about this behavior?
stem.zh: 一名3歲未修補法洛氏四重症兒童的家長表示，孩子玩耍時常會停下來蹲踞一會兒再繼續活動。護理師應如何教導家長理解此行為？

options.en: Squatting is a dangerous sign that requires an emergency department visit every time it occurs
options.zh: 蹲踞是危險徵象，每次發生都須立即送急診

options.en: Squatting is a compensatory position that increases venous return and systemic vascular resistance to improve oxygenation
options.zh: 蹲踞是一種代償姿勢，可增加靜脈回流與全身血管阻力以改善血氧

options.en: Squatting means the child is having a seizure and needs to be physically restrained
options.zh: 蹲踞代表孩子正在癲癇發作，需要約束肢體

options.en: Squatting means the ventricular septal defect has closed and surgery is no longer needed
options.zh: 蹲踞代表心室中隔缺損已經自行閉合，不再需要手術

why.en: In tetralogy of Fallot, squatting is a compensatory mechanism that increases systemic vascular resistance and venous return to the heart, improving blood oxygenation; it is a hallmark finding rather than an emergency in itself, although hypercyanotic (tet) spells triggered by crying or feeding still require prompt intervention.
why.zh: 在法洛氏四重症中，蹲踞是一種代償機轉，可增加全身血管阻力與靜脈回流，改善血液氧合，是此疾病的典型表現，本身並非急症；但哭鬧、餵食等誘發的缺氧發作（tet spell）仍需立即處理。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A newborn is diagnosed with hypoplastic left heart syndrome and is awaiting surgical palliation. Which nursing actions does the nurse anticipate in the preoperative period? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 一名新生兒診斷為左心發育不全症候群，正等待手術姑息治療。護理師預期術前會採取下列哪些護理措施？（複選）

options.en: Administering a continuous intravenous infusion of prostaglandin E1 to maintain ductal patency
options.zh: 持續靜脈輸注前列腺素E1以維持動脈導管開放

options.en: Providing mechanical ventilatory support
options.zh: 提供機械通氣支持

options.en: Monitoring closely for progressive cyanosis and decreased cardiac output as the ductus arteriosus closes
options.zh: 密切監測動脈導管關閉時逐漸惡化的發紺與心輸出量下降徵象

options.en: Discontinuing the prostaglandin infusion as soon as oxygen saturation improves
options.zh: 一旦血氧飽和度改善即停止前列腺素輸注

options.en: Encouraging large-volume oral feedings before surgery to promote weight gain
options.zh: 鼓勵術前大量經口餵食以促進體重增加

why.en: In hypoplastic left heart syndrome, systemic blood flow depends on a patent ductus arteriosus, so the newborn requires a continuous PGE1 infusion and mechanical ventilation preoperatively, and the nurse monitors for deterioration as ductal closure approaches. Stopping the infusion or giving large-volume feedings would be inappropriate given the infant's critical, ductal-dependent status.
why.zh: 左心發育不全的全身血流仰賴動脈導管保持開放，因此新生兒術前需持續輸注前列腺素E1並接受機械通氣，護理師需監測導管逐漸關閉時的惡化徵象；在此危急、導管依賴的狀態下，不應停止輸注或給予大量經口餵食。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child is scheduled for a diagnostic cardiac catheterization in the morning. Which information should the nurse obtain and document before the procedure? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 一名兒童預定於明早接受診斷性心導管檢查。護理師應於術前取得並記錄下列哪些資訊？（複選）

options.en: History of allergic reaction to iodine
options.zh: 碘過敏史

options.en: Presence of a diaper rash or other signs of infection
options.zh: 尿布疹或其他感染徵象

options.en: Accurate current height and weight
options.zh: 準確的目前身高與體重

options.en: Baseline bilateral pulses, including dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial
options.zh: 基礎雙側脈搏，包括足背動脈與後脛動脈

options.en: The child's favorite stuffed animal brought from home
options.zh: 孩子從家裡帶來的最愛玩偶

options.en: Baseline oxygen saturation
options.zh: 基礎血氧飽和度

why.en: Before cardiac catheterization, the nurse assesses for iodine allergy (contrast exposure), signs of infection such as diaper rash, accurate height/weight (for catheter sizing and medication dosing), baseline bilateral distal pulses for postprocedure comparison, and baseline oxygen saturation. A comfort item from home can help with coping but is not a safety-related preprocedure assessment.
why.zh: 心導管檢查前，護理師需評估碘過敏史（顯影劑暴露）、感染徵象如尿布疹、準確身高體重（用於選擇導管大小與藥物劑量計算）、基礎雙側遠端脈搏（供術後比較），以及基礎血氧飽和度；安撫玩具有助於應對但非安全相關之術前評估項目。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: Four hours after a cardiac catheterization via the right femoral artery, the nurse notes the right foot is cool, pale, and the pedal pulse is difficult to palpate compared with the left foot. What should the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 右股動脈心導管檢查後4小時，護理師發現右足冰冷、蒼白，足背脈搏較左足難以觸及。護理師首先應採取何種行動？

options.en: Document the finding and reassess in 2 hours
options.zh: 記錄此發現，2小時後再評估

options.en: Elevate the right leg above heart level and apply a warm blanket
options.zh: 將右腿抬高於心臟水平以上並覆蓋溫毯

options.en: Notify the health care provider immediately because this suggests arterial obstruction
options.zh: 立即通知醫療人員，因這提示動脈阻塞

options.en: Remove the pressure dressing to inspect the insertion site
options.zh: 移除加壓敷料以檢查穿刺部位

why.en: Coolness, pallor, and a diminished or absent pulse distal to a femoral arterial catheterization site are signs of arterial obstruction and must be reported immediately; routine rewarming measures or removing the dressing would delay treatment of a potential limb-threatening complication.
why.zh: 股動脈穿刺部位遠端出現冰冷、蒼白及脈搏減弱或消失，提示動脈阻塞，須立即通報；常規保暖措施或移除敷料會延誤處理此可能危及肢體的併發症。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse provides discharge teaching to parents of a 7-year-old following open-heart surgery. Which statements by the parents indicate correct understanding? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 護理師為一名7歲開心手術後兒童的家長提供出院衛教。下列哪些家長說法顯示正確理解？（複選）

options.en: "Our child can return to school about the third week after discharge, starting with half-days."
options.zh: 「孩子出院後約第三週可返校，先從半天開始。」

options.en: "Our child will need to avoid physical education class for about 2 months."
options.zh: 「孩子約需避免上體育課2個月。」

options.en: "We should schedule dental visits every 6 months once our child turns 3, and tell the dentist about the heart surgery."
options.zh: 「孩子滿3歲後應每6個月看一次牙醫，並告知牙醫心臟手術史。」

options.en: "We will have our child catch up on all missed immunizations within the first week home."
options.zh: 「我們會在回家第一週內補齊所有錯過的疫苗。」

options.en: "We can discipline our child the same way we did before the surgery."
options.zh: 「我們可以用跟手術前一樣的方式管教孩子。」

why.en: Children typically return to school about the third week after discharge, starting with half-days, and avoid physical education for about 2 months; dental visits every 6 months after age 3 with disclosure of the cardiac history (for possible antibiotic prophylaxis) are recommended, and normal discipline is encouraged. Immunizations, invasive procedures, and dental visits are avoided for about 2 months after surgery, not resumed immediately.
why.zh: 兒童通常於出院後第三週返校並從半天開始；約2個月內避免體育課；滿3歲後每6個月看牙醫並告知心臟病史（可能需預防性抗生素）；可維持正常管教方式。手術後約2個月內應避免接種疫苗、侵入性處置與牙科治療，而非立即補齊疫苗。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child's workup reveals polyarthralgia, a temperature of 38.4°C (101.1°F) that spikes in the late afternoon, an elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and a prolonged PR interval on ECG, along with a positive throat culture for group A Streptococcus and a rising anti-streptolysin O titer. The nurse recognizes that confirming a diagnosis of rheumatic fever using the Jones criteria would also require which additional finding?
stem.zh: 一名兒童的檢查顯示多發性關節痛、體溫38.4°C（101.1°F）且於午後升高、紅血球沉降速率（ESR）升高、心電圖PR間期延長，並有A群鏈球菌喉部培養陽性與上升的ASO抗體價。護理師了解依Jones準則確診風濕熱還需要下列哪項額外發現？

options.en: A second elevated inflammatory marker such as C-reactive protein
options.zh: 另一項發炎指標升高，如C反應蛋白

options.en: At least one major criterion, such as carditis, migratory polyarthritis, chorea, erythema marginatum, or subcutaneous nodules
options.zh: 至少一項主要準則，如心臟炎、游走性多發性關節炎、舞蹈症、環形紅斑或皮下結節

options.en: A repeat throat culture in 2 weeks
options.zh: 2週後重複喉部培養

options.en: Evidence of a urinary tract infection
options.zh: 尿路感染的證據

why.en: The findings described (polyarthralgia, fever, elevated ESR, prolonged PR interval) are all MINOR Jones criteria. Diagnosis requires either two major criteria or one major plus two minor criteria, together with evidence of a preceding streptococcal infection; because only minor criteria are present here, at least one major criterion is still needed.
why.zh: 題述之多發性關節痛、發燒、ESR升高、PR間期延長皆屬Jones「次要」準則。確診需2項主要準則，或1項主要加2項次要準則，並合併先前鏈球菌感染證據；由於目前僅具備次要準則，仍需至少一項主要準則才能確診。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child with suspected rheumatic fever has painful, swollen joints, but the diagnosis has not yet been confirmed. Which nursing action is most appropriate for managing the child's joint discomfort at this time?
stem.zh: 一名疑似風濕熱兒童出現關節疼痛腫脹，但尚未確診。此時處理其關節不適最適當的護理措施為何？

options.en: Administer the prescribed aspirin dose immediately to reduce inflammation
options.zh: 立即給予已開立的阿斯匹靈劑量以消炎

options.en: Apply alternating hot and cold applications and gentle massage as prescribed, and maintain bed rest
options.zh: 依醫囑採交替冷熱敷與輕柔按摩，並維持臥床休息

options.en: Encourage the child to ambulate frequently to prevent joint stiffness
options.zh: 鼓勵孩子多下床走動以預防關節僵硬

options.en: Withhold all comfort measures until the diagnosis is confirmed
options.zh: 在確診前，暫停所有舒適照護措施

why.en: Salicylates and anti-inflammatory agents are not given before the diagnosis is confirmed because they can mask polyarthritis and interfere with diagnostic accuracy. Nonpharmacologic comfort measures such as alternating hot/cold applications and gentle massage as prescribed, along with bed rest during the acute febrile phase, are appropriate in the meantime.
why.zh: 確診前不給予水楊酸類與抗發炎藥物，因其可能掩蓋多發性關節炎而影響診斷準確性。此時可依醫囑採行交替冷熱敷、輕柔按摩等非藥物舒適措施，並於急性發熱期維持臥床休息。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child with Kawasaki disease is prescribed intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). Which nursing consideration is most important because IVIG is classified as a blood product?
stem.zh: 一名川崎病兒童開立靜脈注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG）。由於IVIG屬於血液製品，下列哪項護理考量最為重要？

options.en: It must be administered through a central line only
options.zh: 必須僅經中央靜脈導管給藥

options.en: It requires blood product administration precautions and monitoring, the same as other blood products
options.zh: 須依血液製品給藥規範執行相關防護與監測

options.en: It can be mixed with the child's next dose of aspirin in the same syringe
options.zh: 可與下一劑阿斯匹靈混合於同一針筒給予

options.en: It eliminates the need for further temperature monitoring
options.zh: 給予後即可不再監測體溫

why.en: IVIG is a blood product, so the nurse follows blood product administration and monitoring precautions when giving it. It is infused intravenously but does not necessarily require a central line, must never be mixed with other medications in the same syringe, and temperature monitoring continues because fever response is tracked to evaluate treatment effectiveness.
why.zh: IVIG屬於血液製品，給藥時須依血液製品相關防護與監測規範執行；給藥途徑為靜脈輸注但非一定需中央靜脈導管，絕不可與其他藥物混合於同一針筒，且仍需持續監測體溫以評估治療效果。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: Six weeks after hospital discharge for Kawasaki disease, a parent tells the nurse, "My child is still so irritable and clingy. I feel like we are doing something wrong." What is the nurse's best response?
stem.zh: 川崎病出院後6週，家長向護理師表示：「我的孩子還是很躁動、很黏人，我覺得我們是不是哪裡做錯了。」護理師最適當的回應為何？

options.en: "Irritability can last up to about 2 months after this illness begins; this is expected, and maintaining consistent routines can help."
options.zh: 「躁動易怒可能持續到發病後約2個月，這是預期中的恢復過程，維持穩定的生活作息會有幫助。」

options.en: "This is unusual and suggests the medication regimen needs to be changed immediately."
options.zh: 「這很不尋常，代表用藥方案必須立即更改。」

options.en: "You should seek a psychiatric evaluation for your child as soon as possible."
options.zh: 「您應該盡快帶孩子去做精神科評估。」

options.en: "This means the disease has returned and the child needs to be hospitalized again."
options.zh: 「這代表疾病復發了，孩子需要再次住院。」

why.en: Parent education for Kawasaki disease notes that irritability may last up to about 2 months after symptom onset. The nurse should reassure the parent that this is an expected part of recovery and encourage supportive, consistent routines, rather than implying treatment failure or disease recurrence.
why.zh: 川崎病家長衛教提到躁動易怒可能持續至發病後約2個月，屬於預期的恢復過程；護理師應給予安心保證並鼓勵維持穩定作息，而非暗示治療失敗或疾病復發。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: Which statement by the parent of a child with suspected acute glomerulonephritis is most consistent with the diagnosis?
stem.zh: 疑似急性腎絲球腎炎孩童之家長，哪項說法最符合此診斷？

options.en: "His urine has looked like cola for two days."
options.zh: 「他的尿液兩天來像可樂。」

options.en: "He has been urinating much more than usual."
options.zh: 「他排尿比平常多很多。」

options.en: "His blood pressure was low at the clinic."
options.zh: 「診所量到血壓偏低。」

options.en: "He had a stomach virus last week."
options.zh: 「他上週得過腸胃炎。」

why.en: Gross hematuria (cola-colored urine) and oliguria with hypertension are classic; a strep throat or skin infection history is expected.
why.zh: 肉眼血尿（可樂色尿）、少尿及高血壓為典型表現；應有鏈球菌咽喉或皮膚感染史。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a child with glomerulonephritis. Which finding indicates fluid volume overload? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 照護腎絲球腎炎孩童，哪些發現顯示體液容積過多？（複選）

options.en: Weight up 2.7 kg in 24 hours
options.zh: 24小時體重增加2.7 kg

options.en: Blood pressure 140/98 mm Hg
options.zh: 血壓140/98 mm Hg

options.en: Distended hand and neck veins
options.zh: 手與頸靜脈擴張

options.en: Sunken fontanel
options.zh: 囟門凹陷

options.en: Bounding pulse
options.zh: 洪脈

why.en: Rapid weight gain, hypertension, venous distention and bounding pulse reflect overload. Sunken fontanel indicates dehydration.
why.zh: 快速增重、高血壓、靜脈擴張與洪脈代表容積過多；囟門凹陷為脫水。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A 3-year-old with nephrotic syndrome has periorbital edema, frothy urine and BP 88/54. Which laboratory finding does the nurse expect?
stem.zh: 3歲腎病症候群孩童，眼周水腫、泡沫尿、血壓88/54。預期哪項檢驗結果？

options.en: Low serum albumin and high lipids
options.zh: 血清白蛋白低、血脂高

options.en: High serum albumin and low lipids
options.zh: 白蛋白高、血脂低

options.en: Elevated ASO titer as the hallmark
options.zh: ASO升高為特徵

options.en: Low hemoglobin with schistocytes
options.zh: 血紅素低並有破碎紅血球

why.en: Nephrotic syndrome shows massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia and hyperlipidemia. Schistocytes/anemia suggest HUS.
why.zh: 腎病症候群為大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白、高血脂；破碎紅血球與貧血見於HUS。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: An anuric child with hemolytic-uremic syndrome is receiving peritoneal dialysis. Which action is appropriate?
stem.zh: 無尿的HUS孩童接受腹膜透析。何者適當？

options.en: Encourage high-potassium foods
options.zh: 鼓勵高鉀食物

options.en: Restrict fluids as prescribed
options.zh: 依醫囑限制水分

options.en: Assess the arteriovenous fistula
options.zh: 評估動靜脈瘻管

options.en: Give a rapid transfusion for anemia
options.zh: 快速輸血治療貧血

why.en: Anuria requires fluid and potassium restriction. PD uses no AV fistula and transfusions are given cautiously to avoid overload.
why.zh: 無尿需限水限鉀；腹膜透析不需瘻管；輸血需謹慎以免液體過量。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A newborn with bladder exstrophy is admitted. Which intervention protects the exposed bladder?
stem.zh: 膀胱外翻新生兒入院。何者可保護外露膀胱？

options.en: Petroleum jelly gauze
options.zh: 凡士林紗布

options.en: Dry sterile gauze
options.zh: 乾無菌紗布

options.en: Sterile nonadherent plastic wrap or dressing
options.zh: 無菌不沾黏塑膠膜或敷料

options.en: Leave uncovered to air
options.zh: 暴露於空氣中

why.en: A nonadherent covering keeps mucosa moist and allows urine drainage without damage. Petroleum jelly and dry gauze adhere and injure tissue.
why.zh: 不沾黏覆蓋可保持黏膜濕潤並讓尿液引流；凡士林與乾紗布會黏附損傷組織。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: After hypospadias repair with a urinary stent, the toddler has had no urine output for 1 hour. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 尿道下裂修補術後留置支架的幼兒，1小時無尿。護理師應？

options.en: Document and recheck in 4 hours
options.zh: 記錄並4小時後再評估

options.en: Notify the surgeon
options.zh: 通知外科醫師

options.en: Restrict fluids
options.zh: 限制水分

options.en: Give a tub bath
options.zh: 盆浴

why.en: No output for an hour may mean a kinked stent or sediment obstruction; report to the surgeon. Fluids are encouraged and tub baths avoided.
why.zh: 1小時無尿可能為支架扭曲或沉積物阻塞，需通報外科醫師；應鼓勵飲水且避免盆浴。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The parents of a 7-year-old with nocturnal enuresis ask about the outlook. Which response is best?
stem.zh: 7歲夜間遺尿孩童的家長詢問預後。何者最佳？

options.en: It is caused by a psychiatric problem.
options.zh: 那是精神問題造成的。

options.en: It does not respond to treatment.
options.zh: 無法治療。

options.en: It is usually outgrown; limiting evening fluids and voiding at bedtime help.
options.zh: 多半會自行好轉；晚間限水與睡前排尿有幫助。

options.en: Surgery is needed.
options.zh: 需要手術。

why.en: Most children outgrow nocturnal enuresis; behavioral measures, alarms or desmopressin may help after pathology is ruled out.
why.zh: 多數兒童會自然好轉；排除病理原因後，行為措施、警報器或desmopressin可輔助。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: Which findings would the nurse expect in a child with newly diagnosed nephrotic syndrome? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 新診斷腎病症候群孩童預期有哪些發現？（複選）

options.en: Pallor
options.zh: 蒼白

options.en: Edema
options.zh: 水腫

options.en: Anorexia
options.zh: 食慾不振

options.en: Proteinuria
options.zh: 蛋白尿

options.en: Weight loss
options.zh: 體重減輕

options.en: Decreased serum lipids
options.zh: 血脂降低

why.en: Weight gain (not loss) from edema and elevated (not decreased) lipids occur.
why.zh: 水腫導致體重增加（非減輕），血脂升高（非降低）。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A mother asks the clinic nurse how to reduce her toddler daughter's risk of developing urinary tract infections. Which instruction should the nurse give?
stem.zh: 一位母親詢問診所護理師如何降低她的幼兒女兒發生泌尿道感染的風險。護理師應給予哪項指導？

options.en: Wipe from front to back after voiding or stooling
options.zh: 排尿或排便後由前往後擦拭

options.en: Give daily bubble baths to keep the perineal area clean
options.zh: 每天泡泡泡浴以保持會陰部清潔

options.en: Limit the child's fluid intake during the day
options.zh: 白天限制孩子的水分攝取

options.en: Dress the child in tight-fitting underwear to prevent soiling
options.zh: 讓孩子穿貼身內褲以避免弄髒

why.en: Proper hygiene, specifically wiping from front to back, helps prevent bacteria from the gastrointestinal tract and skin flora from entering the urethra. Bubble baths, tight underwear, and limiting fluids all increase UTI risk rather than reduce it.
why.zh: 正確的衛生習慣，尤其是由前往後擦拭，可避免腸胃道與皮膚上的菌叢進入尿道。泡泡浴、貼身內褲與限制水分攝取反而會增加泌尿道感染的風險。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse is assigned to four children on a pediatric unit. Which child should the nurse assess first?
stem.zh: 護理師被分配照護小兒科病房的四名兒童。護理師應優先評估哪一位？

options.en: A child 2 days post-orchiopexy who is resting comfortably with a clean dressing
options.zh: 輸精管固定術後第2天、休息舒適且敷料乾淨的兒童

options.en: A child with acute glomerulonephritis whose blood pressure rose from 128/84 to 156/100 mm Hg with a new severe headache
options.zh: 急性腎小球腎炎的兒童，其血壓由128/84上升至156/100 mmHg，並出現新發生的劇烈頭痛

options.en: A child with nephrotic syndrome who has 2+ periorbital edema this morning, unchanged from yesterday
options.zh: 腎病症候群的兒童，今晨眼周水腫2+，與昨日相比無變化

options.en: A child 6 hours post-hypospadias repair with a urethral stent draining clear yellow urine
options.zh: 尿道下裂修補術後6小時、尿道支架引流出清澈黃色尿液的兒童

why.en: A sharp rise in blood pressure with a new severe headache in a child with glomerulonephritis suggests evolving hypertensive encephalopathy, a complication that can progress rapidly to seizures and requires immediate assessment and provider notification. The other children have stable or expected findings.
why.zh: 腎小球腎炎兒童血壓急速上升合併新發生的劇烈頭痛，提示可能正發展為高血壓腦病，此併發症可迅速進展為癲癇發作，需立即評估並通知醫師。其他兒童的情況皆屬穩定或預期範圍內。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse is caring for an 8-year-old with acute glomerulonephritis. Which finding should be reported to the primary health care provider immediately?
stem.zh: 護理師正在照護一名患有急性腎小球腎炎的8歲兒童。應立即向醫療人員報告哪項發現？

options.en: Urine that is dark, cola-colored, and foamy
options.zh: 尿液呈深色、可樂色且帶泡沫

options.en: Mild periorbital puffiness that is more noticeable on awakening
options.zh: 輕微眼周浮腫，晨起時較明顯

options.en: Blood pressure of 158/102 mm Hg with a new, severe headache
options.zh: 血壓158/102 mmHg並新發生劇烈頭痛

options.en: Poor appetite, having eaten only half of breakfast
options.zh: 食慾不佳，早餐只吃了一半

why.en: Hematuria, periorbital edema, and anorexia are expected findings in glomerulonephritis. A marked rise in blood pressure accompanied by severe headache signals hypertensive encephalopathy, a complication that can progress to seizures and requires immediate intervention.
why.zh: 血尿、眼周水腫與食慾不振為腎小球腎炎的常見表現。但血壓明顯上升合併劇烈頭痛，提示高血壓腦病，此併發症可能進展為癲癇發作，需立即處理。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse wants to detect early fluid retention in a child hospitalized with glomerulonephritis. Which nursing action provides the most reliable information?
stem.zh: 護理師想要及早發現腎小球腎炎住院兒童的體液滯留情形。哪項護理措施能提供最可靠的資訊？

options.en: Measuring daily weight on the same scale, at the same time, in similar clothing
options.zh: 每日於同一時間、使用同一體重計、穿著相近衣物測量體重

options.en: Asking the parent each shift whether the child appears more swollen
options.zh: 每班詢問家長孩子是否看起來更腫

options.en: Checking capillary refill on the fingertips every 4 hours
options.zh: 每4小時檢查指尖毛細血管充盈時間

options.en: Comparing today's calorie intake with yesterday's intake
options.zh: 比較今日與昨日的熱量攝取

why.en: A consistent daily weight, taken under the same conditions, is the most sensitive and objective indicator of fluid retention; a gain of about 0.5 kg (1 lb) in a day reflects fluid accumulation. Subjective reports, capillary refill, and calorie comparisons do not reliably detect early fluid shifts.
why.zh: 在相同條件下每日測量體重，是偵測體液滯留最敏感且客觀的指標；一天內增加約0.5公斤（1磅）即代表液體蓄積。主觀描述、毛細血管充盈與熱量比較皆無法可靠偵測早期體液變化。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A 2-year-old is admitted with suspected nephrotic syndrome. Which assessment findings would the nurse expect to find? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 一名2歲兒童因疑似腎病症候群入院。護理師預期會發現哪些評估結果？請選出所有適用項目。

options.en: Generalized edema, more pronounced periorbitally in the morning
options.zh: 全身性水腫，晨起時眼周更明顯

options.en: Massive proteinuria with dark, frothy urine
options.zh: 大量蛋白尿，尿液深色且帶泡沫

options.en: Elevated serum lipid levels
options.zh: 血脂升高

options.en: Weight loss over the past several days
options.zh: 過去數天體重減輕

options.en: Blood pressure that is significantly elevated above baseline
options.zh: 血壓明顯高於基礎值

options.en: Pallor and anorexia
options.zh: 臉色蒼白與食慾不振

why.en: Nephrotic syndrome classically presents with massive proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, and generalized edema that is most prominent periorbitally in the morning, along with pallor, anorexia, and weight gain (not loss). Blood pressure is usually normal or only slightly decreased, not significantly elevated.
why.zh: 腎病症候群的典型表現為大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白血症、高血脂症與全身性水腫，晨起時眼周水腫最明顯，並伴隨臉色蒼白、食慾不振與體重增加（而非減輕）。血壓通常正常或略為偏低，而非明顯升高。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A child with nephrotic syndrome has just started high-dose corticosteroid therapy. Which teaching point is most important for the nurse to include for the parents?
stem.zh: 一名腎病症候群兒童剛開始接受高劑量類固醇治療。護理師應向家長提供哪項最重要的指導？

options.en: Watch for and report signs of infection, since the medication can mask or increase susceptibility to infection
options.zh: 觀察並回報感染徵象，因為此藥物可能掩蓋感染或增加感染風險

options.en: The medication should be stopped as soon as the edema resolves
options.zh: 一旦水腫消退就應停藥

options.en: The child should avoid all dietary sodium restriction while taking this medication
options.zh: 服用此藥期間應避免任何飲食鈉限制

options.en: This medication cures the underlying kidney disease permanently
options.zh: 此藥物能永久治癒潛在的腎臟疾病

why.en: Corticosteroids are a mainstay of therapy for nephrotic syndrome, but they increase susceptibility to infection and can mask typical signs of infection, so parents must be taught to monitor for and promptly report fever or other signs of infection. Steroids are tapered as prescribed, not stopped abruptly; sodium restriction may still be needed during edema; and the medication induces remission rather than a permanent cure.
why.zh: 類固醇是腎病症候群治療的主要藥物，但會增加感染風險並可能掩蓋典型的感染徵象，因此家長須被教導要監測並立即回報發燒或其他感染徵象。類固醇需依醫囑逐漸減量，不可驟然停藥；水腫期間仍可能需限鈉；此藥物是誘導緩解，而非永久治癒。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A toddler is admitted with suspected hemolytic-uremic syndrome (HUS). Which laboratory findings would support this diagnosis? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 一名幼兒因疑似溶血性尿毒症候群（HUS）入院。哪些檢驗結果可支持此診斷？請選出所有適用項目。

options.en: Decreased platelet count
options.zh: 血小板數降低

options.en: Decreased hemoglobin and hematocrit
options.zh: 血紅素與血細胞比容降低

options.en: Elevated blood urea nitrogen and serum creatinine
options.zh: 血中尿素氮與血清肌酸酐升高

options.en: Increased reticulocyte count
options.zh: 網狀紅血球計數增加

options.en: Decreased white blood cell count
options.zh: 白血球數降低

why.en: HUS is characterized by the triad of hemolytic anemia (decreased hemoglobin/hematocrit with an increased reticulocyte count as the bone marrow compensates), thrombocytopenia, and acute kidney injury (elevated BUN and creatinine). White blood cell count is not characteristically decreased in HUS.
why.zh: HUS的三大特徵為溶血性貧血（血紅素/血細胞比容降低，骨髓代償使網狀紅血球增加）、血小板減少，以及急性腎損傷（BUN與肌酸酐升高）。白血球數並非HUS的典型特徵性降低表現。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A child with hemolytic-uremic syndrome has become anuric and is beginning peritoneal dialysis. Which intervention should the nurse plan to implement?
stem.zh: 一名溶血性尿毒症候群兒童已出現無尿，並開始接受腹膜透析。護理師應計畫執行哪項措施？

options.en: Restrict fluids as prescribed
options.zh: 依醫囑限制水分攝取

options.en: Encourage foods high in potassium
options.zh: 鼓勵攝取高鉀食物

options.en: Care for an arteriovenous fistula at the dialysis access site
options.zh: 照護透析通路部位的動靜脈瘻管

options.en: Encourage a high-sodium diet to replace losses
options.zh: 鼓勵高鈉飲食以補充流失

why.en: A child who is anuric requires fluid restriction to prevent fluid overload; potassium and sodium intake are also typically restricted, not encouraged, in acute kidney injury. Peritoneal dialysis uses a peritoneal catheter, not an arteriovenous fistula, which is specific to hemodialysis.
why.zh: 無尿的兒童需限制水分攝取以避免體液過荷；在急性腎損傷期間，鉀與鈉的攝取通常也需限制而非鼓勵。腹膜透析使用的是腹膜導管，動靜脈瘻管則用於血液透析。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A 3-year-old has had three febrile urinary tract infections in the past year. The provider suspects vesicoureteral reflux (VUR). Which diagnostic test does the nurse anticipate will be scheduled to confirm the diagnosis?
stem.zh: 一名3歲兒童在過去一年內已發生三次發熱性泌尿道感染，醫師懷疑為膀胱輸尿管逆流（VUR）。護理師預期會安排哪項檢查以確診？

options.en: Voiding cystourethrogram
options.zh: 排尿性膀胱尿道攝影

options.en: Renal biopsy
options.zh: 腎臟活體組織切片

options.en: Electroencephalogram
options.zh: 腦電圖

options.en: Bone marrow aspiration
options.zh: 骨髓穿刺

why.en: VUR, the backflow of urine from the bladder into the ureters and kidneys, is diagnosed with imaging studies such as abdominal ultrasound and a voiding cystourethrogram, which visualizes reflux during voiding. A renal biopsy, EEG, and bone marrow aspiration are not used to diagnose this condition.
why.zh: VUR是指尿液由膀胱逆流至輸尿管及腎臟，其診斷依賴影像學檢查，如腹部超音波及排尿性膀胱尿道攝影，可於排尿時觀察逆流情形。腎臟活體切片、腦電圖與骨髓穿刺皆非用於診斷此病症的檢查。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A 6-year-old who has been fully toilet trained and dry at night for over a year suddenly begins wetting the bed nightly and complains of burning with urination. What is the nurse's priority action?
stem.zh: 一名6歲兒童已完全接受大小便訓練且已有一年以上夜間不尿床，卻突然開始每夜尿床並訴說排尿時有灼熱感。護理師應優先採取哪項行動？

options.en: Reassure the parents that this is normal primary nocturnal enuresis
options.zh: 向家長保證這是正常的原發性夜間遺尿

options.en: Obtain a urine specimen for urinalysis and culture
options.zh: 採集尿液進行尿液分析與尿液培養

options.en: Recommend fluid restriction after dinner only
options.zh: 建議晚餐後限制水分攝取

options.en: Begin a reward-based behavioral conditioning program immediately
options.zh: 立即開始以獎勵為基礎的行為制約計畫

why.en: New-onset bedwetting after a period of established continence is secondary enuresis; when accompanied by dysuria, this warrants assessment for a urinary tract infection before any behavioral intervention is pursued. This is not primary nocturnal enuresis, since the child had already established nighttime dryness.
why.zh: 在已建立控尿能力後突然出現尿床屬於次發性遺尿；若合併排尿疼痛，應先評估是否為泌尿道感染，再考慮任何行為介入。此情況並非原發性夜間遺尿，因為孩子原本已具備夜間控尿能力。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse is teaching the parents of a 7-year-old prescribed desmopressin for nighttime enuresis. Which statement by the parents indicates correct understanding of this medication's purpose?
stem.zh: 護理師正教導一名7歲兒童的家長，該兒童因夜間遺尿而使用desmopressin。家長的哪項陳述顯示其正確理解此藥物的作用？

options.en: "This medication helps reduce the amount of urine my child's body makes at night."
options.zh: 「這個藥物能減少我孩子夜間身體製造的尿量。」

options.en: "This medication will cure the bedwetting permanently after one course."
options.zh: 「這個藥物吃一個療程後就能永久治好尿床。」

options.en: "This medication strengthens the bladder muscle so it holds more urine."
options.zh: 「這個藥物能強化膀胱肌肉讓它能裝更多尿液。」

options.en: "I should encourage extra fluids in the evening while my child is on this medication."
options.zh: 「服用這個藥物期間我應該讓孩子晚上多喝水。」

why.en: Desmopressin is an antidiuretic that reduces nighttime urine production; it does not strengthen bladder muscle (that is the mechanism of anticholinergics) and is not a guaranteed permanent cure. Evening fluids should be limited, not encouraged, while the child is on this therapy.
why.zh: Desmopressin是一種抗利尿藥物，能減少夜間尿液的產生；它並不會強化膀胱肌肉（那是抗膽鹼藥物的作用機轉），也不保證能永久治癒。使用此藥期間應限制而非鼓勵晚間水分攝取。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse provides discharge teaching to the parents of a toddler who had an orchiopexy for cryptorchidism. Which statement by the parents indicates a need for further instruction?
stem.zh: 護理師為一名接受輸精管固定術治療隱睪症的幼兒家長提供出院指導。家長的哪項陳述顯示需要進一步指導？

options.en: "I'll check his temperature over the next few days."
options.zh: 「接下來幾天我會幫他量體溫。」

options.en: "I'll give the pain medicine as prescribed if he seems uncomfortable."
options.zh: 「如果他看起來不舒服，我會依醫囑給止痛藥。」

options.en: "Since he's walking fine today, he can ride his ride-on toy again tomorrow."
options.zh: 「他今天走得很好，明天就可以再騎他的跨騎玩具了。」

options.en: "I'll let the surgeon know if he doesn't urinate for several hours."
options.zh: 「如果他好幾個小時沒有排尿，我會告知外科醫師。」

why.en: Vigorous and straddling activities (such as ride-on toys, tricycles, and similar) need to be restricted for about 2 weeks after orchiopexy to prevent dislodging the internal suture line and promote healing, regardless of how well the child appears to be walking. Monitoring temperature, administering pain medication as prescribed, and monitoring voiding are all appropriate.
why.zh: 輸精管固定術後約2週內須限制劇烈及跨騎類活動（如跨騎玩具、三輪車等），以避免移位內部縫線並促進癒合，即使孩子走路看起來正常也是如此。量體溫、依醫囑給止痛藥及觀察排尿狀況皆屬正確措施。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: An infant is 2 hours postoperative following hypospadias repair with a urethral stent in place. The nurse notes no urine in the collection bag for the past 90 minutes. What is the nurse's priority action?
stem.zh: 一名嬰兒於尿道下裂修補術後2小時，裝有尿道支架。護理師發現過去90分鐘內收集袋內無尿液。護理師應優先採取哪項行動？

options.en: Continue to monitor and reassess in another hour
options.zh: 持續觀察並於1小時後再評估

options.en: Encourage oral fluids and recheck output in 30 minutes
options.zh: 鼓勵口服補液並於30分鐘後再次檢查尿量

options.en: Notify the pediatric surgeon
options.zh: 通知小兒外科醫師

options.en: Irrigate the stent with sterile saline
options.zh: 以無菌生理食鹽水灌洗支架

why.en: No urinary output for 1 hour or more after hypospadias repair may indicate a kink, obstruction by sediment, or other problem with the urinary diversion or stent and should be reported to the surgeon promptly; the stent should not be irrigated without a specific order.
why.zh: 尿道下裂修補術後若1小時以上無尿液排出，可能代表尿路分流管或支架扭結、被沉積物阻塞或其他問題，應立即通報外科醫師；未經特別醫囑不應自行灌洗支架。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: A newborn is diagnosed with bladder exstrophy shortly after birth. Until surgical closure can be performed, which nursing intervention best protects the exposed bladder mucosa?
stem.zh: 一名新生兒出生後不久被診斷為膀胱外翻。在手術修補前，哪項護理措施最能保護外露的膀胱黏膜？

options.en: Cover the bladder with a sterile, nonadherent dressing that allows urine drainage while preventing the tissue from drying out
options.zh: 以無菌、不沾黏的敷料覆蓋膀胱，使尿液可引流出來，同時避免組織乾燥

options.en: Apply petroleum jelly gauze to keep the tissue moist
options.zh: 塗抹凡士林紗布以保持組織濕潤

options.en: Cover the area with dry sterile gauze and change it only once daily
options.zh: 以乾燥無菌紗布覆蓋，且每日只更換一次

options.en: Leave the bladder mucosa completely uncovered to allow air exposure
options.zh: 讓膀胱黏膜完全暴露於空氣中，不加任何覆蓋

why.en: The exposed bladder mucosa must be kept from drying out while still allowing urine to drain, which is achieved with a sterile, nonadherent dressing. Petroleum jelly gauze dries out, adheres to the mucosa, and damages delicate tissue on removal; dry gauze also allows the tissue to dry out; and leaving it uncovered does not protect the fragile mucosa.
why.zh: 外露的膀胱黏膜須避免乾燥，同時仍需讓尿液能夠引流，使用無菌、不沾黏的敷料可達成此目的。凡士林紗布會乾燥並沾黏於黏膜上，移除時會損傷脆弱組織；乾燥紗布同樣會使組織乾燥；完全不覆蓋則無法保護脆弱的黏膜。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: The parents of a newborn just diagnosed with bladder exstrophy are visibly distressed and keep asking why this happened to their baby. Which nursing response is most therapeutic?
stem.zh: 剛被診斷出膀胱外翻的新生兒父母明顯顯得心煩意亂，不斷詢問為什麼這會發生在他們的寶寶身上。護理師哪項回應最具治療性？

options.en: "Tell me more about what's worrying you most right now."
options.zh: 「告訴我，現在最讓你擔心的是什麼？」

options.en: "Try not to worry — the surgeons fix this all the time."
options.zh: 「別太擔心——醫師常常在處理這種情況。」

options.en: "These things happen; there's nothing anyone could have done."
options.zh: 「這種事情就是會發生，誰也無能為力。」

options.en: "Let's focus on practical matters like feeding right now instead."
options.zh: 「我們現在先專注在實際的事情上，比如餵奶就好。」

why.en: Open-ended questions that invite parents to express their specific fears and concerns are therapeutic and allow the nurse to provide targeted emotional support and information. Minimizing the concern, offering premature reassurance, or redirecting away from their feelings shuts down communication rather than supporting it.
why.zh: 開放式問句能邀請家長表達具體的恐懼與擔憂，具有治療性，並讓護理師能提供針對性的情緒支持與資訊。輕描淡寫、過早給予安慰或轉移話題皆會阻斷溝通，而非給予支持。

t.zh: 腎臟與泌尿生殖問題（兒科）

stem.en: During a confidential portion of a well visit, a sexually active 16-year-old asks the nurse about getting tested for sexually transmitted infections (STIs) without the parent finding out. What is the nurse's best response?
stem.zh: 在健康檢查的保密談話時段，一名有性行為的16歲青少年詢問護理師是否能在家長不知情的情況下接受性傳染病（STI）篩檢。護理師最佳的回應是什麼？

options.en: Explain the clinic's confidentiality policies for adolescent STI screening and arrange the appropriate testing
options.zh: 說明診所對青少年STI篩檢的保密政策，並安排適當的檢測

options.en: Tell the adolescent that parental consent is always required before any STI testing
options.zh: 告知青少年所有STI檢測皆一定需要家長同意

options.en: Advise the adolescent to ask the parent to be present before discussing this further
options.zh: 建議青少年先請家長到場後再進一步討論

options.en: Avoid answering and refer the adolescent to search for information independently online
options.zh: 不回答此問題，請青少年自行上網查詢資訊

why.en: Adolescents and certain children are offered screening for specific STIs as part of standard health promotion care, and clinics follow confidentiality protections appropriate to the adolescent's age and the service requested. The nurse should provide accurate information and facilitate screening rather than requiring parental presence or deflecting the question.
why.zh: 青少年及某些兒童依標準健康促進照護原則，可接受特定STI的篩檢，診所也會依青少年的年齡及所需服務提供適當的保密保護。護理師應提供正確資訊並協助安排篩檢，而非要求家長必須在場或迴避此問題。

stem.en: A 5-year-old fell from a bunk bed. Which is a LATE sign of increased intracranial pressure?
stem.zh: 5歲兒童從上下鋪跌落。何者為ICP上升的晚期徵象？

options.en: Headache
options.zh: 頭痛

options.en: Nausea
options.zh: 噁心

options.en: Bradycardia
options.zh: 心搏過緩

options.en: Irritability
options.zh: 易怒

why.en: Bradycardia, marked LOC decrease, pupil changes, posturing and Cheyne-Stokes are late; headache, nausea, irritability are early.
why.zh: 心搏過緩、意識明顯下降、瞳孔改變、僵直與陳施氏呼吸為晚期；頭痛、噁心、易怒為早期。

options.en: Daily weight
options.zh: 每日測體重

options.en: Clear liquids

options.en: Test the drainage for glucose and notify the provider if positive
options.zh: 檢測液體葡萄糖，陽性則通報醫師

options.en: Clear hard objects away

stem.en: A newborn has an intact-looking myelomeningocele sac. Which nursing action is correct?
stem.zh: 新生兒有脊髓脊膜膨出，囊完整。何者正確？

options.en: Place supine and apply a dry gauze pad
options.zh: 仰臥並覆蓋乾紗布

options.en: Place prone and cover the sac with a sterile moist nonadherent saline dressing
options.zh: 俯臥並以無菌濕潤不沾黏生理食鹽水敷料覆蓋囊

options.en: Apply powder to the sac
options.zh: 囊上撒粉

options.en: Use latex gloves for all care
options.zh: 全程使用乳膠手套

why.en: Prone position reduces tension; moist nonadherent dressing protects tissue. Latex must be avoided.
why.zh: 俯臥減少囊張力；濕潤不沾黏敷料保護組織；需避免乳膠。

why.zh: 一致性與安全為優先；避免要求與環境變動。

stem.en: The nurse is assessing a 9-month-old infant brought to the emergency department after falling from a changing table 1 hour ago. The infant is awake, alert, and interactive. Which assessment finding would provide the nurse with the earliest indication that the infant's neurological status is beginning to deteriorate?
stem.zh: 護理師在急診室評估一名9個月大的嬰兒，該嬰兒1小時前從換尿布台跌落。嬰兒目前清醒、警醒且能互動。下列哪項評估發現能讓護理師最早察覺嬰兒神經功能狀態開始惡化？

options.en: A 2-cm increase in head circumference
options.zh: 頭圍增加2公分

options.en: A subtle decrease in the infant's level of consciousness, such as decreased alertness
options.zh: 意識程度出現輕微下降，例如警醒度降低

options.en: A bulging anterior fontanel
options.zh: 前囟門膨出

options.en: Dilated scalp veins
options.zh: 頭皮靜脈擴張

why.en: The child's level of consciousness is the earliest indicator of improvement or deterioration in neurological status after a head injury. Head circumference changes, fontanel bulging, and dilated scalp veins are findings associated with increased ICP but develop more slowly and are not as immediately sensitive as a change in alertness.
why.zh: 頭部外傷後，意識程度是神經功能狀態改善或惡化最早的指標。頭圍改變、囟門膨出與頭皮靜脈擴張都是顱內壓升高的相關徵象，但出現較慢，敏感度不如意識改變。

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a 6-year-old who is 18 hours post closed head injury from a fall. Which finding requires the nurse to notify the primary health care provider immediately?
stem.zh: 護理師照護一名6歲兒童，其因跌倒造成閉鎖性頭部外傷已18小時。下列哪項發現需要護理師立即通知醫療人員？

options.en: Mild headache relieved by acetaminophen
options.zh: 服用乙醯胺酚後頭痛減輕

options.en: Pulse rate that has slowed from 98 to 54 beats/min with a widening pulse pressure
options.zh: 脈搏由每分鐘98次減緩至54次，且脈壓變寬

options.en: Child asking for something to drink
options.zh: 孩童要求喝水

options.en: Slight irritability when awakened for neurological checks
options.zh: 進行神經評估叫醒時略顯躁動

why.en: A slowing pulse with widening pulse pressure, together with altered respirations and pupil changes, indicates brainstem involvement and impending herniation from rising ICP; this is a neurological emergency requiring immediate notification of the PHCP. The other findings are expected or minor.
why.zh: 脈搏減緩合併脈壓變寬，加上呼吸型態與瞳孔改變，提示腦幹受壓與顱內壓升高導致的腦疝即將發生，屬於神經系統急症，需立即通知醫療人員。其他選項為預期或輕微發現。

stem.en: A 4-year-old child with a seizure disorder begins having a generalized tonic-clonic seizure while standing at the sink brushing their teeth. Which action should the nurse take first?
stem.zh: 一名4歲患有癲癇的兒童在水槽邊刷牙時突然發生全身性強直-陣攣發作。護理師應優先採取下列哪項行動？

options.en: Insert a padded tongue blade between the child's teeth
options.zh: 在孩童牙齒間放入包墊過的壓舌板

options.en: Ease the child to the floor and turn the child to a side-lying position
options.zh: 將孩童輕緩放至地面並擺成側臥姿勢

options.en: Restrain the child's arms and legs to prevent injury
options.zh: 約束孩童的四肢以防止受傷

options.en: Leave the child briefly to retrieve the suction equipment
options.zh: 暫時離開去拿抽吸設備

why.en: The first priority is to protect the child from injury by easing the child to the floor and positioning on the side, which also helps maintain airway patency. Nothing is ever placed in the mouth during a seizure, the child is never restrained, and the nurse should not leave an actively seizing child unattended.
why.zh: 首要優先是保護孩童避免受傷，將孩童輕緩放至地面並採側臥姿勢，同時有助於維持呼吸道通暢。發作時絕不可在口中放置任何物品，也不可約束孩童，護理師亦不應在孩童仍在發作時離開。

stem.en: The nurse is implementing seizure precautions for a hospitalized 7-year-old with a new diagnosis of a seizure disorder. Which actions should the nurse include in the plan of care? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 護理師為一名新診斷為癲癇、住院中的7歲兒童執行癲癇防護措施。下列哪些行動應納入照護計畫？（請選出所有適用項目）

options.en: Pad the side rails of the bed
options.zh: 在床側護欄加裝護墊

options.en: Keep suction equipment and oxygen at the bedside
options.zh: 在床邊備妥抽吸設備與氧氣

options.en: Keep a padded tongue blade taped to the head of the bed
options.zh: 將包墊過的壓舌板用膠帶固定在床頭備用

options.en: Clear the area of hard objects and hazards
options.zh: 清除周圍的硬物與危險物品

options.en: Place a waterproof mattress or pad on the bed
options.zh: 在床上鋪防水床墊或防水墊

options.en: Alert all caregivers that the child is on seizure precautions
options.zh: 告知所有照護人員該孩童正執行癲癇防護措施

why.en: Seizure precautions include padding the side rails, keeping suction/oxygen available, clearing the area of hazards, using a waterproof mattress pad, and alerting caregivers. A tongue blade or any object is never placed in or near the mouth because it can cause injury to the teeth, gums, or airway.
why.zh: 癲癇防護措施包括在護欄加裝護墊、備妥抽吸設備與氧氣、清除周圍危險物品、使用防水床墊，以及告知所有照護人員。絕不可在口中或口邊放置壓舌板或任何物品，因可能造成牙齒、牙齦或呼吸道受傷。

stem.en: A 5-year-old is admitted after a motor vehicle crash with a suspected basilar skull fracture. The nurse notes clear drainage from the child's nose. Which nursing action is most appropriate to determine whether this drainage is cerebrospinal fluid?
stem.zh: 一名5歲兒童因車禍入院，疑似顱底骨折。護理師發現其鼻腔有清澈分泌物流出。下列哪項護理行動最適合用來判斷此分泌物是否為腦脊髓液？

options.en: Measure the pH of the drainage with litmus paper
options.zh: 使用石蕊試紙測量分泌物的酸鹼值

options.en: Test the drainage for glucose using a reagent strip
options.zh: 使用試紙檢測分泌物中的葡萄糖

options.en: Send a sample of the drainage for a complete blood count
options.zh: 將分泌物送驗全血球計數

options.en: Culture the drainage for bacterial growth
options.zh: 將分泌物送驗細菌培養

why.en: Drainage from the nose or ear after a head injury is tested for glucose with a reagent strip; CSF contains glucose, so a positive glucose result suggests CSF leakage, and the PHCP must be notified immediately. pH testing, a CBC, or culture would not confirm CSF leakage.
why.zh: 頭部外傷後鼻腔或耳部的分泌物應使用試紙檢測葡萄糖；腦脊髓液含有葡萄糖，若葡萄糖檢測呈陽性，提示可能為腦脊髓液滲漏，須立即通知醫療人員。酸鹼值、全血球計數或培養皆無法確認腦脊髓液滲漏。

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a 10-year-old with a basilar skull fracture. The child develops copious nasal secretions. Which prescription should the nurse clarify with the primary health care provider before implementing?
stem.zh: 護理師照護一名10歲顱底骨折兒童，該兒童出現大量鼻腔分泌物。護理師應針對下列哪項醫囑向醫療人員澄清後再執行？

options.en: Obtain daily weights
options.zh: 每日測量體重

options.en: Provide clear liquids as tolerated
options.zh: 依耐受程度提供清流質

options.en: Perform nasotracheal suctioning as needed for secretions
options.zh: 依需要經鼻氣管抽吸分泌物

options.en: Maintain the intravenous line
options.zh: 維持靜脈輸液管路

why.en: Nasotracheal (nasal) suctioning is contraindicated in a child with a basilar skull fracture because the catheter could enter the brain through the fracture, creating a high risk of secondary infection. The nurse should clarify this prescription rather than implement it as written.
why.zh: 顱底骨折的兒童禁止經鼻抽吸，因導管可能經骨折處進入腦部，造成嚴重續發性感染風險。護理師應先與醫療人員澄清此醫囑，而非直接執行。

stem.en: The nurse is caring for four pediatric clients. Which client should the nurse assess first?
stem.zh: 護理師負責照護四名兒科病人。護理師應優先評估下列哪一位？

options.en: An infant with a ventriculoperitoneal shunt who is now feeding poorly and has a high-pitched, shrill cry
options.zh: 一名裝有腹腔靜脈引流分流管的嬰兒，目前餵食不佳且出現高音尖銳哭聲

options.en: A child with cerebral palsy who is due for a scheduled physical therapy session
options.zh: 一名腦性麻痺兒童，依排程須進行物理治療

options.en: A child with a history of absence seizures who is sitting quietly in a chair
options.zh: 一名有失神性發作病史的兒童，正安靜坐在椅子上

options.en: A child with mild intellectual disability who is participating in a supervised play activity
options.zh: 一名輕度智能障礙兒童，正參與有人監督的遊戲活動

why.en: A high-pitched, shrill cry and poor feeding in an infant with a ventriculoperitoneal shunt are early signs of shunt malfunction or infection and increased ICP, requiring immediate assessment. The other clients are stable and do not reflect an acute change.
why.zh: 裝有腹腔靜脈分流管的嬰兒出現高音尖銳哭聲與餵食不佳，是分流管故障或感染及顱內壓升高的早期徵象，需立即評估。其他病人狀況穩定，並無急性變化。

stem.en: An infant returns to the pediatric unit after placement of a ventriculoperitoneal shunt. Which positioning instruction should the nurse follow unless increased ICP develops?
stem.zh: 一名嬰兒在接受腹腔靜脈分流手術後返回兒科病房。除非出現顱內壓升高，護理師應遵循下列哪項擺位指示？

options.en: Position the infant on the operative side
options.zh: 使嬰兒側臥於手術側

options.en: Position the infant on the nonoperative side and keep the infant flat as prescribed
options.zh: 使嬰兒側臥於未手術側，並依醫囑保持平躺

options.en: Keep the head of the bed elevated 45 degrees at all times
options.zh: 床頭隨時抬高45度

options.en: Place the infant in a prone position
options.zh: 使嬰兒維持俯臥

why.en: Postoperatively, the infant is positioned on the unoperated (nonoperative) side to prevent pressure on the shunt valve, and the infant is kept flat if prescribed to avoid a rapid reduction in intracranial fluid. If increased ICP develops, the head of the bed is elevated 15 to 30 degrees to enhance gravity flow through the shunt.
why.zh: 術後應讓嬰兒側臥於未手術側以避免壓迫分流閥，並依醫囑保持平躺以避免顱內液體過快減少。若出現顱內壓升高，則將床頭抬高15至30度以利藉重力促進分流管引流。

stem.en: A 3-year-old is admitted with suspected bacterial meningitis. A lumbar puncture is performed and antibiotics are started. Which precaution should the nurse maintain?
stem.zh: 一名3歲兒童因疑似細菌性腦膜炎入院。已完成腰椎穿刺並開始使用抗生素。護理師應維持下列哪項防護措施？

options.en: Enteric precautions for the duration of hospitalization
options.zh: 住院期間全程採取腸道傳染防護措施

options.en: Neutropenic precautions until the white blood cell count normalizes
options.zh: 直到白血球數值恢復正常前採取嗜中性白血球低下防護措施

options.en: Respiratory isolation precautions for at least 24 hours after antibiotics are started
options.zh: 開始使用抗生素後至少維持24小時呼吸道隔離防護措施

options.en: No special precautions once antibiotics have been administered
options.zh: 一旦開始使用抗生素即不需任何特殊防護措施

why.en: Bacterial meningitis is spread by droplets from nasopharyngeal secretions, so respiratory isolation precautions are maintained for at least 24 hours after antibiotics are initiated. Enteric and neutropenic precautions are unrelated to the mode of transmission of meningitis.
why.zh: 細菌性腦膜炎經由鼻咽分泌物飛沫傳播，因此在開始使用抗生素後需維持至少24小時的呼吸道隔離防護措施。腸道防護與嗜中性白血球低下防護與腦膜炎的傳播途徑無關。

stem.en: The nurse reviews cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis results for a 6-year-old with suspected bacterial meningitis. Which set of findings is most consistent with this diagnosis?
stem.zh: 護理師查閱一名6歲疑似細菌性腦膜炎兒童的腦脊髓液分析結果。下列哪組結果最符合此診斷？

options.en: Clear CSF, decreased pressure, decreased protein
options.zh: 清澈腦脊髓液、壓力降低、蛋白質降低

options.en: Cloudy CSF, increased pressure, increased protein, decreased glucose
options.zh: 混濁腦脊髓液、壓力升高、蛋白質升高、葡萄糖降低

options.en: Clear CSF, normal pressure, normal glucose
options.zh: 清澈腦脊髓液、壓力正常、葡萄糖正常

options.en: Cloudy CSF, decreased pressure, increased glucose
options.zh: 混濁腦脊髓液、壓力降低、葡萄糖升高

why.en: In bacterial meningitis, CSF obtained by lumbar puncture is cloudy with increased pressure, an increased white blood cell count, elevated protein, and decreased glucose. Clear CSF with normal values is more consistent with viral meningitis or a normal finding.
why.zh: 細菌性腦膜炎經腰椎穿刺取得的腦脊髓液呈混濁狀，壓力升高、白血球數增加、蛋白質升高且葡萄糖降低。清澈且數值正常的腦脊髓液較符合病毒性腦膜炎或正常表現。

stem.en: The nurse is teaching the parents of a 4-year-old who has recovered from influenza about preventing Reye's syndrome during future febrile illnesses. Which statements by the parents indicate correct understanding? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 護理師針對一名剛從流感康復的4歲兒童之父母進行衛教，說明未來發燒疾病期間如何預防雷氏症候群。下列父母的敘述中，哪些顯示其理解正確？（請選出所有適用項目）

options.en: "I will give acetaminophen for fever instead of aspirin."
options.zh: 「我會給退燒藥乙醯胺酚，而不是阿斯匹靈。」

options.en: "Ibuprofen is an acceptable medication to give for fever."
options.zh: 「布洛芬是可以用來退燒的藥物。」

options.en: "Aspirin is fine to use as long as the dose is low."
options.zh: 「只要劑量低，使用阿斯匹靈沒關係。」

options.en: "I will avoid giving any aspirin-containing products during a viral illness."
options.zh: 「病毒性疾病期間我會避免給予任何含阿斯匹靈的產品。」

options.en: "Reye's syndrome is linked to aspirin use during illnesses such as influenza or chickenpox."
options.zh: 「雷氏症候群與流感或水痘等疾病期間使用阿斯匹靈有關。」

why.en: Aspirin and aspirin-containing products are avoided in children with a febrile illness, varicella, or influenza because of the association with Reye's syndrome. Acetaminophen and ibuprofen are the medications of choice. There is no safe low dose of aspirin recommended during these illnesses.
why.zh: 患有發燒疾病、水痘或流感的兒童應避免使用阿斯匹靈及含阿斯匹靈的產品，因其與雷氏症候群有關。乙醯胺酚與布洛芬為首選退燒藥物。並無建議在這些疾病期間使用「低劑量」阿斯匹靈的安全做法。

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a newborn with a myelomeningocele before surgical repair. Which nursing action is most appropriate to protect the sac?
stem.zh: 護理師照護一名尚未接受手術修補、患有脊髓脊膜膨出的新生兒。下列哪項護理措施最適合用來保護囊袋？

options.en: Position the newborn supine to prevent pressure on the lesion
options.zh: 使新生兒採仰臥姿勢以避免壓迫病灶

options.en: Cover the sac with a sterile, dry gauze dressing
options.zh: 以無菌乾紗布覆蓋囊袋

options.en: Cover the sac with a sterile, moist, nonadherent dressing and position the newborn prone
options.zh: 以無菌、濕潤（生理食鹽水）、不沾黏敷料覆蓋囊袋，並使新生兒採俯臥姿勢

options.en: Apply a diaper snugly over the sac for protection
options.zh: 在囊袋上緊密包覆尿布以保護

why.en: The sac is protected by covering it with a sterile, moist (normal saline) nonadherent dressing to keep the sac and its contents moist, and the newborn is positioned prone to minimize tension on the sac and risk of trauma; diapering may be contraindicated until repair.
why.zh: 應以無菌、濕潤（生理食鹽水）、不沾黏的敷料覆蓋囊袋，以維持囊袋與其內容物的濕潤，並使新生兒採俯臥姿勢以降低囊袋張力及受傷風險；修補前可能禁止包尿布。

stem.en: A child with ADHD is started on a stimulant medication. Which finding should the nurse instruct the parents to report to the primary health care provider?
stem.zh: 一名罹患注意力不足過動症的兒童開始服用中樞神經興奮劑。護理師應指導父母將下列哪項發現報告醫療人員？

options.en: Mild decrease in appetite at lunch
options.zh: 午餐時食慾略微下降

options.en: Difficulty falling asleep on the first night of the medication
options.zh: 服藥第一晚入睡困難

options.en: Development of a new facial tic
options.zh: 出現新的臉部抽動（tic）

options.en: Slightly increased talkativeness
options.zh: 話變得稍微多一些

why.en: A new tic is a notable adverse effect of stimulant medications used for ADHD and should be reported to the PHCP. Appetite suppression, insomnia, and nervousness are known possible side effects, but a new tic warrants prompt provider notification and medication reevaluation.
why.zh: 新出現的抽動（tic）是ADHD用興奮劑藥物值得注意的不良反應，應報告醫療人員。食慾抑制、失眠與緊張為已知可能的副作用，但新出現的抽動需立即通知醫療人員並重新評估藥物。

stem.en: A child in temporary skin traction for a femur fracture has an absent dorsalis pedis pulse on the affected foot. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 股骨骨折暫時使用皮膚牽引的孩童，患足足背動脈消失。護理師應？

options.en: Administer an analgesic
options.zh: 給止痛藥

options.en: Release the traction
options.zh: 放鬆牽引

options.en: Apply ice
options.zh: 冰敷

options.en: Notify the provider immediately
options.zh: 立即通知醫師

why.en: Absent pulse suggests compromised circulation/compartment syndrome, an emergency. Ice worsens perfusion; traction is not released without an order.
why.zh: 脈搏消失提示循環受損/骨筋膜室症候群，為緊急狀況；冰敷會惡化灌流；無醫囑不可放鬆牽引。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which finding in a 1-month-old suggests developmental dysplasia of the hip?
stem.zh: 1個月大嬰兒哪項發現提示DDH？

options.en: Symmetrical gluteal folds
options.zh: 臀紋對稱

options.en: Limited abduction of the affected hip
options.zh: 患側髖外展受限

options.en: Lengthened femur on the affected side
options.zh: 患側股骨變長

options.en: Positive Babinski
options.zh: Babinski陽性

why.en: DDH shows limited abduction, asymmetric folds and apparent shortening (Galeazzi).
why.zh: DDH表現為外展受限、臀紋不對稱與肢體縮短（Galeazzi）。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statement by a parent of an infant in a Pavlik harness shows understanding?
stem.zh: Pavlik吊帶嬰兒的家長哪項說法顯示理解？

options.en: "I will remove it every few hours to let him stretch."
options.zh: 「我每幾小時取下讓他伸展。」

options.en: "It stays on 23 hours a day and comes off only for baths."
options.zh: 「每天戴23小時，洗澡才取下。」

options.en: "I will put powder under the straps."
options.zh: 「我會在帶子下撒粉。」

options.en: "It will be worn for 1 week."
options.zh: 「只需戴一週。」

why.en: The harness is worn nearly continuously for about 6-12 weeks.
why.zh: 吊帶需幾乎持續配戴約6-12週。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A child who had spinal fusion for scoliosis develops vomiting and abdominal distention. What is the best action?
stem.zh: 脊椎融合術後孩童出現嘔吐與腹脹。最佳行動？

options.en: Give an antiemetic and observe
options.zh: 給止吐藥並觀察

options.en: Increase IV fluids
options.zh: 增加靜脈輸液

options.en: Notify the provider
options.zh: 通知醫師

options.en: Place in prone position
options.zh: 俯臥

why.en: These signs suggest superior mesenteric artery syndrome mimicking obstruction/ileus.
why.zh: 這些徵象提示腸繫膜上動脈症候群，類似腸阻塞/麻痺性腸阻塞。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which instructions are correct for a child with a scoliosis brace? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 脊柱側彎背架孩童哪些指導正確？（複選）

options.en: Wear soft cloth under the brace
options.zh: 架下穿柔軟衣物

options.en: Apply lotion under the brace
options.zh: 架下擦乳液

options.en: Inspect skin for redness
options.zh: 檢查皮膚是否發紅

options.en: Perform prescribed exercises
options.zh: 進行指定運動

options.en: Avoid powder
options.zh: 避免使用粉

why.en: Lotions and powders cake and break down skin.
why.zh: 乳液與粉會結塊並破壞皮膚。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: During a painful flare of juvenile idiopathic arthritis, what exercise advice is best?
stem.zh: JIA疼痛發作期，最佳運動建議？

options.en: Avoid all exercise
options.zh: 避免所有運動

options.en: Do simple isometric exercises
options.zh: 做簡單等長運動

options.en: Do vigorous resistance training
options.zh: 做激烈阻力訓練

options.en: Only bed rest for 2 weeks
options.zh: 臥床兩週

why.en: Isometric exercise and neutral positioning maintain function during flares.
why.zh: 發作期等長運動與中立位擺位維持功能。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statement shows a parent needs further teaching about plaster cast care?
stem.zh: 哪項家長說法顯示石膏照護需再衛教？

options.en: "The cast may feel warm as it dries."
options.zh: 「石膏乾燥時會發熱。」

options.en: "I'll use powder around the edges for itching."
options.zh: 「癢時邊緣撒粉。」

options.en: "I will keep the arm elevated for 24-48 hours."
options.zh: 「前24-48小時抬高手臂。」

options.en: "I'll call if his fingers become numb."
options.zh: 「手指麻木我會打電話。」

why.en: Powders/lotions near cast edges irritate skin and may fall inside.
why.zh: 石膏邊緣用粉或乳液會刺激皮膚並可能掉入內部。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A 10-year-old with osteomyelitis is to start IV antibiotics. What must be done first?
stem.zh: 10歲骨髓炎孩童將開始靜脈抗生素。首先應完成？

options.en: Obtain cultures
options.zh: 採集培養檢體

options.en: Place in a spica cast
options.zh: 打髖人字石膏

options.en: Begin weight-bearing exercise
options.zh: 開始承重運動

options.en: Apply heat
options.zh: 熱敷

why.en: Antibiotics are started after appropriate cultures are obtained.
why.zh: 於取得適當培養後才開始抗生素。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: The nurse is assisting with the examination of a 2-week-old infant for developmental dysplasia of the hip. The primary health care provider abducts the infant's flexed thighs and applies gentle forward pressure over the greater trochanter, eliciting a palpable clunk. Which test is being performed?
stem.zh: 護理師協助醫療人員檢查一名2週大嬰兒是否有發展性髖關節發育不良。醫療人員將嬰兒屈曲的大腿外展，並於大轉子處施加輕柔向前的壓力，誘發出可觸及的「喀」聲。此為下列哪項測試？

options.en: Barlow's test
options.zh: Barlow氏測試

options.en: Ortolani's test
options.zh: Ortolani氏測試

options.en: Trendelenburg's test
options.zh: Trendelenburg氏測試

options.en: Galeazzi sign assessment
options.zh: Galeazzi徵象評估

why.en: Ortolani's maneuver involves abducting the thighs and applying gentle forward pressure over the greater trochanter; a palpable clunk or click indicates the femoral head moving into the acetabulum, confirming hip instability. Barlow's test uses adduction with posterior pressure to detect a dislocatable hip.
why.zh: Ortolani氏測試是將大腿外展並於大轉子處施加輕柔向前壓力；觸及「喀」聲或喀啦感表示股骨頭移入髖臼，確認髖關節不穩定。Barlow氏測試則是內收並向後下方施壓，以偵測可脫位的髖關節。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is teaching the parents of a newborn with developmental dysplasia of the hip about care of the Pavlik harness. Which instruction should the nurse include?
stem.zh: 護理師針對一名患有發展性髖關節發育不良新生兒的父母，衛教Pavlik吊帶的照護方式。護理師應納入下列哪項指導？

options.en: Remove the harness only for bathing
options.zh: 僅在洗澡時取下吊帶

options.en: Remove the harness for 2 hours each day for skin care
options.zh: 每天取下吊帶2小時以進行皮膚護理

options.en: The harness is worn only during sleep
options.zh: 吊帶只在睡眠時穿戴

options.en: The harness may be removed for feeding
options.zh: 餵食時可以取下吊帶

why.en: The Pavlik harness is worn continuously, approximately 23 hours per day, and is removed only for bathing. It is not removed for feeding or for extended periods, as continuous positioning is needed to maintain hip flexion and abduction.
why.zh: Pavlik吊帶需持續穿戴，每天約23小時，僅在洗澡時取下。不應在餵食時或長時間取下，因需持續維持髖關節屈曲外展的姿勢。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A 3-day-old infant has a clubfoot deformity and the plan is to begin serial manipulation and casting. Which statement by the parent indicates understanding of the treatment plan?
stem.zh: 一名3天大嬰兒有馬蹄足畸形，計畫開始進行連續手法矯正與石膏固定。下列哪項父母的敘述顯示其理解治療計畫？

options.en: "The cast will be changed about once a month."
options.zh: 「石膏大約每個月更換一次。」

options.en: "My baby will need a new cast about once a week for several weeks."
options.zh: 「我的寶寶在接下來幾週內大約每週都需要換一次新石膏。」

options.en: "Once this cast is removed in a few weeks, no further follow-up is needed."
options.zh: 「這個石膏拆掉幾週後，就不需要再追蹤了。」

options.en: "Treatment can wait until my baby starts walking."
options.zh: 「可以等寶寶開始走路後再治療。」

why.en: Manipulation and casting for clubfoot are performed weekly for about 8 to 12 weeks because of the rapid growth of early infancy. Treatment begins as soon after birth as possible, and long-term interval follow-up is required until skeletal maturity.
why.zh: 馬蹄足的手法矯正與石膏固定因嬰兒早期生長快速，需每週進行，約持續8至12週。治療應盡早在出生後開始，且需長期間歇追蹤直到骨骼發育成熟。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A 13-year-old is 6 hours postoperative following spinal fusion for scoliosis. The nurse notes new-onset vomiting and abdominal distention. Which action should the nurse take first?
stem.zh: 一名13歲兒童因脊椎融合術治療脊柱側彎，術後6小時。護理師發現新出現嘔吐與腹部膨脹。護理師應優先採取下列哪項行動？

options.en: Administer the prescribed antiemetic and reassess
options.zh: 給予醫囑止吐藥後再評估

options.en: Increase the rate of the intravenous fluids
options.zh: 增加靜脈輸液速率

options.en: Notify the primary health care provider
options.zh: 通知醫療人員

options.en: Place the child in a left lateral position and encourage oral fluids
options.zh: 使孩童採左側臥並鼓勵口服液體

why.en: Vomiting and abdominal distention after spinal fusion surgery may indicate superior mesenteric artery syndrome, a complication caused by mechanical changes in abdominal contents after surgery that mimics intestinal obstruction. The PHCP should be notified promptly for further evaluation; administering an antiemetic, increasing fluids, or giving oral fluids would not address the underlying problem.
why.zh: 脊椎融合手術後出現嘔吐與腹部膨脹可能提示上腸系膜動脈症候群，這是手術後腹腔內容物機械性改變所致的併發症，表現類似腸阻塞。應立即通知醫療人員進一步評估；給予止吐藥、增加輸液或給予口服液體均無法處理根本問題。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is teaching the parents of an adolescent who will be wearing a brace for scoliosis. Which statement by the parent indicates a need for further teaching?
stem.zh: 護理師衛教一名需配戴脊柱側彎支架的青少年之父母。下列哪項父母的敘述顯示需要進一步指導？

options.en: "I will have my child wear a soft cotton shirt under the brace."
options.zh: 「我會讓孩子在支架下穿柔軟的棉質上衣。」

options.en: "I will apply lotion to my child's skin under the brace each morning to prevent irritation."
options.zh: 「我每天早上會在支架下的皮膚塗抹乳液以預防刺激。」

options.en: "I will check my child's skin daily for redness."
options.zh: 「我會每天檢查孩子的皮膚是否有發紅。」

options.en: "The brace is usually worn 16 to 23 hours a day."
options.zh: 「支架通常每天需配戴16到23小時。」

why.en: Lotions and powders are avoided under a brace because they can become sticky or caked and lead to skin breakdown. Wearing soft clothing under the brace, checking the skin daily, and the typical wear schedule of 16 to 23 hours a day are all appropriate.
why.zh: 支架下應避免使用乳液或痱子粉，因其可能變得黏膩或結塊而導致皮膚破損。在支架下穿柔軟衣物、每天檢查皮膚，以及每天配戴16至23小時的配戴時程，皆為正確做法。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A 12-year-old newly diagnosed with scoliosis will begin wearing a brace. Which nursing action best addresses the psychosocial needs of this child?
stem.zh: 一名12歲兒童新診斷脊柱側彎，即將開始配戴支架。下列哪項護理措施最能滿足此孩童的心理社會需求？

options.en: Encourage the child to verbalize feelings about body image and wearing the brace
options.zh: 鼓勵孩童表達對身體意象與配戴支架的感受

options.en: Discourage the child from discussing the brace with peers
options.zh: 勸阻孩童與同儕討論支架的事

options.en: Advise the child to avoid looking in the mirror while wearing the brace
options.zh: 建議孩童配戴支架時避免看鏡子

options.en: Focus teaching only on the mechanics of the brace
options.zh: 僅針對支架的使用機制進行衛教

why.en: A child with a disabling condition requiring a body brace is at risk for altered body image, fear, anger, and isolation. Encouraging verbalization of feelings about body image and related psychosocial issues is an important nursing intervention.
why.zh: 需配戴身體支架的身心障礙狀況兒童，有身體意象改變、恐懼、憤怒與孤立感的風險。鼓勵其表達對身體意象與相關心理社會議題的感受，是重要的護理措施。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child with juvenile idiopathic arthritis calls the clinic reporting a painful exacerbation with swollen, stiff joints. The parent asks whether the child should continue range-of-motion exercises. Which response by the nurse is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 一名患有幼年型特異性關節炎的兒童家屬致電診所，表示孩童目前疾病急性惡化、關節腫脹僵硬疼痛，並詢問是否應繼續進行關節活動度運動。護理師應如何回應最為恰當？

options.en: "Avoid all exercise until the pain resolves completely."
options.zh: 「在疼痛完全消失前，請避免所有運動。」

options.en: "Continue full range-of-motion exercises as usual."
options.zh: 「請照常進行完整的關節活動度運動。」

options.en: "Have the child perform simple isometric exercises instead of full range-of-motion exercises during this time."
options.zh: 「這段時間讓孩子做簡單的等長運動，而非完整的關節活動度運動。」

options.en: "Exercise is not helpful for this condition and can be stopped permanently."
options.zh: 「運動對此疾病沒有幫助，可以永久停止。」

why.en: During a painful exacerbation of juvenile idiopathic arthritis, hot or cold packs, splinting, and neutral joint positioning help reduce pain; simple isometric exercises, which do not involve joint movement, should be started as soon as the child is able rather than full ROM exercises or complete avoidance of all activity.
why.zh: 幼年型特異性關節炎急性發作疼痛期間，冷熱敷、固定及將關節維持在中立姿勢有助於減輕疼痛；應儘快開始不涉及關節活動的簡單等長運動，而非完整關節活動度運動或完全避免所有活動。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is caring for an adolescent diagnosed with Marfan syndrome. Which instruction is most important for the nurse to include in discharge teaching?
stem.zh: 護理師照護一名診斷為馬凡氏症候群的青少年。下列哪項指導是護理師在出院衛教中最重要應納入的？

options.en: "Participate in competitive contact sports to build muscle strength."
options.zh: 「參加競賽型接觸性運動以增強肌力。」

options.en: "Avoid competitive athletics and contact sports."
options.zh: 「避免競賽型運動與接觸性運動。」

options.en: "No follow-up eye examinations are needed unless vision changes occur."
options.zh: 「除非視力出現變化，否則不需要追蹤眼科檢查。」

options.en: "Dental visits do not require any special precautions."
options.zh: 「牙科就診不需要任何特別預防措施。」

why.en: Marfan syndrome affects the skeletal, cardiovascular, and ocular systems; children need to avoid competitive athletics and contact sports to prevent injury to the heart and aorta. Regular vision examinations are needed, and antibiotics are often required before dental procedures to prevent endocarditis.
why.zh: 馬凡氏症候群影響骨骼、心血管與眼部系統；兒童需避免競賽型運動與接觸性運動，以防心臟與主動脈受傷。需定期接受視力檢查，且牙科處置前常需使用抗生素以預防心內膜炎。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A 6-year-old with Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease reports hip and groin pain and has been limping for several weeks. Which pathophysiological process explains these findings?
stem.zh: 一名6歲兒童患有Legg-Calvé-Perthes疾病，主訴髖部與腹股溝疼痛，且已跛行數週。下列哪項病理生理機轉可解釋這些發現？

options.en: Autoimmune inflammation of the synovial joint
options.zh: 滑膜關節的自體免疫發炎

options.en: Temporary interruption of blood supply to the femoral head, causing bone death
options.zh: 股骨頭血液供應暫時中斷，導致骨骼壞死

options.en: Bacterial infection of the bone
options.zh: 骨骼細菌感染

options.en: Improper seating of the femoral head in the acetabulum present since birth
options.zh: 自出生起股骨頭在髖臼中位置不正

why.en: Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease occurs when the blood supply to the femoral head is temporarily interrupted, causing the bone to die and stop growing, which results in limping and hip, groin, thigh, or knee pain with limited range of motion. It is not an autoimmune, infectious, or congenital dysplastic process.
why.zh: Legg-Calvé-Perthes疾病是因股骨頭血液供應暫時中斷，導致骨骼壞死並停止生長，造成跛行及髖部、腹股溝、大腿或膝部疼痛，並伴隨活動度受限。並非自體免疫、感染或先天髖關節發育不良的過程。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: A child is in Russell skin traction for a fractured femur. Which assessment finding requires the nurse's immediate action?
stem.zh: 一名兒童因股骨骨折正接受Russell皮膚牽引。下列哪項評估發現需要護理師立即採取行動？

options.en: The weights are hanging freely without touching the floor
options.zh: 重物懸空，未接觸地面

options.en: The child reports mild discomfort relieved with position change
options.zh: 孩童主訴輕微不適，變換姿勢後緩解

options.en: The affected foot is cool, pale, and the child reports numbness and tingling
options.zh: 患肢腳部冰冷、蒼白，孩童主訴麻木與刺痛感

options.en: The ropes are seated properly within the pulley grooves
options.zh: 繩索正確置於滑輪溝槽中

why.en: Coolness, pallor, numbness, and tingling in the affected extremity are signs of neurovascular/circulatory impairment, which may indicate compartment syndrome and require immediate notification of the PHCP. Properly functioning traction with freely hanging weights and ropes seated in the pulleys are expected, correct findings.
why.zh: 患肢出現冰冷、蒼白、麻木與刺痛感，提示神經血管循環受損，可能為肌筋膜腔症候群的徵象，需立即通知醫療人員。重物自由懸空且繩索正確置於滑輪中則屬於牽引功能正常、預期的發現。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a child who had a plaster cast applied to the right leg 2 hours ago for a tibial fracture. Which finding is the priority to report to the primary health care provider?
stem.zh: 護理師照護一名兒童，其右腿因脛骨骨折於2小時前上了石膏。下列哪項發現是護理師最優先應報告醫療人員的？

options.en: The cast still feels warm to the touch
options.zh: 石膏摸起來仍感覺溫熱

options.en: The child states the leg itches under the cast
options.zh: 孩童表示石膏內的腿會癢

options.en: Pain in the right foot that is increasing despite analgesics, with the toes cool and difficult to move
options.zh: 右腳疼痛持續加劇，即使使用止痛藥仍無法緩解，且腳趾冰冷、活動困難

options.en: The child wants to rest the leg on a pillow
options.zh: 孩童想把腿放在枕頭上休息

why.en: Pain out of proportion to the injury that worsens despite analgesics, along with coolness and decreased mobility of the toes, are signs of compartment syndrome, a limb-threatening emergency that requires immediate reporting. A warm-feeling drying cast, itching, and elevating the leg on a pillow are expected or appropriate findings.
why.zh: 疼痛程度超出預期且使用止痛藥仍持續加劇，合併腳趾冰冷與活動度降低，是肌筋膜腔症候群的徵象，屬於威脅肢體的緊急狀況，須立即報告。石膏乾燥時感覺溫熱、搔癢及將腿抬高放於枕頭上均屬預期或恰當的發現。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is providing home care instructions to the parents of a child who just had a plaster cast applied to the forearm. Which instructions should be included? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 護理師為一名剛於前臂上石膏的兒童之父母提供居家照護指導。下列哪些指導應納入？（請選出所有適用項目）

options.en: Use the palms of the hands, not the fingertips, to lift or handle the cast while it is drying
options.zh: 石膏未乾前，應以手掌而非指尖來搬動或托扶石膏

options.en: Keep small toys and sharp objects away from the cast
options.zh: 將小玩具與尖銳物品遠離石膏

options.en: Insert a padded object inside the cast if the skin itches
options.zh: 若皮膚發癢，可將包墊過的物品放入石膏內止癢

options.en: Elevate the extremity on pillows for the first 24 to 48 hours
options.zh: 上石膏後最初24至48小時內，將肢體墊高

options.en: Apply a heating pad to the cast if the fingers feel cold
options.zh: 若手指感覺冰冷，可在石膏上使用電熱毯

options.en: Notify the primary health care provider if the child reports numbness or tingling
options.zh: 若孩童主訴麻木或刺痛感，應通知醫療人員

why.en: The palms (not fingertips) are used to handle a drying cast to avoid creating indentations; small objects and sharp items are kept away from and out of the cast; the extremity is elevated for the first 24 to 48 hours to reduce swelling; and numbness or tingling is reported immediately. No object is ever inserted inside a cast, and a heating pad is never applied, since cold fingers may indicate neurovascular impairment requiring provider notification, not warming.
why.zh: 石膏未乾時應以手掌而非指尖搬動，以避免造成壓痕；應將小物品與尖銳物品遠離並禁止放入石膏內；最初24至48小時應將肢體墊高以減輕腫脹；出現麻木或刺痛應立即通知醫療人員。絕不可在石膏內放入任何物品，也不可使用電熱毯，因手指冰冷可能提示神經血管循環受損，需通知醫療人員而非加溫處理。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a child with acute osteomyelitis of the tibia. Which intervention should the nurse anticipate during the acute phase of treatment?
stem.zh: 護理師照護一名脛骨急性骨髓炎的兒童。在治療急性期，護理師應預期採取下列哪項措施？

options.en: Encourage full weight-bearing ambulation to maintain muscle strength
options.zh: 鼓勵完全負重行走以維持肌力

options.en: Maintain non-weight-bearing status on the affected leg with positions of comfort
options.zh: 使患肢維持不負重狀態，並採取舒適姿勢

options.en: Apply a heating pad directly to the affected extremity
options.zh: 直接在患肢上使用電熱毯

options.en: Restrict all physical and occupational therapy until antibiotics are complete
options.zh: 在抗生素療程結束前完全限制所有物理及職能治療

why.en: During the acute phase of osteomyelitis, the affected extremity is kept non-weight-bearing, with positions of comfort and temporary splints/casts as needed. Weight-bearing ambulation is avoided, and developmentally appropriate activities and physical/occupational therapy are initiated as appropriate, not withheld entirely.
why.zh: 骨髓炎急性期應使患肢維持不負重狀態，並依需要採取舒適姿勢或使用暫時性護木／石膏。應避免負重行走，並依狀況適時啟動符合發展年齡的活動與物理／職能治療，而非完全限制。

src: Original NCLEX-style item, written for this site

t.zh: 免疫問題與傳染病（兒科）

stem.en: An infant of an HIV-positive parent is monitored. Which sign suggests the most common opportunistic infection?
stem.zh: HIV陽性父母的嬰兒接受監測。哪項徵象提示最常見的伺機性感染？

options.en: Cough
options.zh: 咳嗽

options.en: Nuchal rigidity
options.zh: 頸部僵硬

options.en: Watery stool
options.zh: 水便

options.en: Jaundice
options.zh: 黃疸

why.en: Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia is most common, around 3-6 months, and presents with cough and respiratory signs.
why.zh: 肺囊蟲肺炎最常見，約3-6個月，表現為咳嗽與呼吸症狀。

stem.en: Which test is most appropriate to diagnose HIV in a 2-month-old born to an HIV-positive parent?
stem.zh: HIV陽性父母所生2個月嬰兒，最適合哪項診斷檢查？

options.en: ELISA
options.zh: ELISA

options.en: Western blot
options.zh: Western blot

options.en: PCR (proviral DNA)
options.zh: PCR（前病毒DNA）

options.en: Chest x-ray
options.zh: 胸部X光

why.en: Maternal antibodies make antibody tests unreliable before 18 months; PCR or p24 antigen is accurate in infants.
why.zh: 母體抗體使18個月前抗體檢測不可靠；PCR或p24抗原適用於嬰兒。

src: Original practice question based on the chapter

t.zh: 免疫問題與傳染病（兒科）

stem.en: Which statements by a parent of a child with HIV show understanding? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: HIV兒童家長哪些說法顯示理解？（複選）

options.en: "I'll clean diaper spills with a bleach solution."
options.zh: 「尿布外溢我用漂白水清理。」

options.en: "He will get the yearly inactivated flu shot."
options.zh: 「他每年會打不活化流感疫苗。」

options.en: "A low-grade fever is fine for day care."
options.zh: 「低燒可以去托育。」

options.en: "I'll wash his dishes in the dishwasher."
options.zh: 「他的餐具用洗碗機洗。」

options.en: "I'll offer high-calorie, high-protein foods."
options.zh: 「我會提供高熱量高蛋白食物。」

why.en: A sick or febrile child stays home; other statements are correct.
why.zh: 生病或發燒的孩子應留在家；其餘皆正確。

t.zh: 免疫問題與傳染病（兒科）

stem.en: The nurse finds small blue-white spots with a red base on the buccal mucosa of a febrile child. Which precautions are required?
stem.zh: 護理師發現發燒孩童頰黏膜有紅底藍白小點。需何種防護？

options.en: Airborne and contact precautions
options.zh: 空氣與接觸防護

options.en: Enteric precautions only
options.zh: 僅腸道防護

options.en: Neutropenic precautions
options.zh: 嗜中性球低下防護

options.en: Standard precautions only
options.zh: 僅標準防護

why.en: Koplik spots indicate measles, which requires airborne plus contact precautions.
why.zh: Koplik斑代表麻疹，需空氣加接觸防護。
